newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-WP TAKE LEAD AGAINST BOLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WP TAKE LEAD AGAINST BOLAND.

text.p: A century from Sven Koenig and two other half centuries put defending champions Western Province into a commanding position on the second day of their Supersport series match with Boland at Newlands on Friday.
Koenig's third century in the competition provided a solid foundation on which HD Ackerman could add 65 and John Commins 53 not out as Western Province closed the day on 336 for five.
That gave them a 97-run lead over Boland, with five wickets in hand and well placed to record a second successive victory.
Koenig put on 102 with Desmond Haynes (33) for the first wicket and 85 with HD Ackerman for the third before his four and a half hour stay was ended.
He hit 15 fours and one six before mistiming spinner Claude Henderson to steeple a catch to mid-on.
His good work was continued with further half-century partnerships between Ackerman and Commins and Commins and Eric Simons -- who struck 38 from 41 balls.
Boland tried seven bowlers but the blustery conditions and benign wicket made for a frustrating day.
Bowling: Millns 20-2-66-2, Telemachus 23-6-58-0, Williams 22-4-70-1, Henderson 30-9-82-2, Kuiper 4-1-16-0, Truter 2-0-16-0, Ackerman 3-0-14-0
